crossRefs.note: Yahweh called to Moses, and spoke to him from the Tent of Meeting, saying,
A voice of tumult from the city, a voice from the temple, a voice of Yahweh that repays his enemies what they deserve.
I heard a loud voice out of the temple, saying to the seven angels, “Go and pour out the seven bowls of the wrath of…
He brought me there; and, behold, there was a man, whose appearance was like the appearance of bronze, with a line of…

translations.web: I heard one speaking to me out of the house; and a man stood by me.
translations.bsb: While the man was standing beside me, I heard someone speaking to me from inside the temple,
translations.kjv: And I heard him speaking unto me out of the house; and the man stood by me.
translations.asv: And I heard one speaking unto me out of the house; and a man stood by me.
